decision.reason: SCMP October 12 highlights molten salt thermal storage and supercritical CO2 generation as potential ways to increase dispatchable grid electricity in China. The article is a technology/industry analysis, not a new plant being commercially available nor binding implementation regulation. Lab/plant engineers could document assumptions and proof-of-concept test-readiness for heat-cycle, salt containment and output with no hardware API in a manual acceptance matrix.

opportunities.idea_name: Molten-Salt / sCO2 Pilot Test Evidence Matrix

opportunities.before_state: Termal demo test senaryoları, malzeme sertifikaları ve mühendislik kararları tablo/deney notu içinde ayrışıyor
opportunities.after_state: Kabul öncesi mühendis onayına hazır varsayım, malzeme, plan/gerçekleşen test ve kalite gap listesi
